stem:
The diagram shows the north end of magnet 1 held near the north end of magnet 2.

What should Danish expect?

options.text: The magnets attract because magnet 1 sits to the left of magnet 2.

teacher.key_rationale: Like poles (N near N) repel. Attraction would reverse the rule. Left-right placement does not decide the force, and the poles do interact.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source cylinders into two bar magnets with N ends facing; stem asks attract or repel.
